method: S3 v1 errors where S4 was right (all 40); categories fixed before reading except weak_evidence, added while reading

categories.early_stop: stopped before the decisive evidence was shown
categories.misjudged: the decisive evidence was shown, but the decision went the other way
categories.detector_lure: false object detections drove a wrong Yes
categories.vocabulary: searched for a concept the lexicon does not cover
categories.label_debatable: the clip's label is itself debatable under the annotation protocol
categories.weak_evidence: the only cue was faint; a No is defensible (added while reading)
